notes: Top street is printed HANIFIELD (no suffix seen in this strip; the brief calls it Hanfield Street). Its north side is the cut top edge of the plate, so its centre line (taken 90 px north of the south lot line, close to the 6 in. water pipe line) is less certain than the others; Florida, Kirby and Gordon run on north through notches in the plate edge. The diagonal street with the car tracks is taken as Colerain Avenue (name not printed inside this strip); centre read on the tracks, midway between the north lot fronts and the southern line. Powers Street is not named inside the strip and its south side is cut by the bottom plate edge: centre y taken as north lot line (about 7118) plus half of the printed 50 ft, so y is uncertain by 20-30 px; east of Borden it is printed 40 ft. Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden appear to run on south of Powers (kind cross is a judgement). Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden end at Hoffner Avenue (cemetery ground to the north). No streets between y 2000 and 5260 (Wesleyan Cemetery, creek). GEO... street joining Hanifield near x 3300 is outside the 300 px margin. | Hanfield Street (name printed only as '...NIFIELD' at the strip's west edge) runs along the cut top edge of the plate: only its south side and the water pipe line are on the plate, so its centre is taken on the pipe line, about 105-115 px north of the south block edge; Florida, Kirby and Gordon show stubs running on north past it. Colerain Avenue is not named inside the strip; it is the 60 ft street with the car track and house numbers 4126-4226. Powers Street is not named inside the strip and is cut by the bottom edge of the plate: only its north side (y about 7110-7122) and a pipe line (y about 7178) show, centre estimated at y 7190 for a 50 ft street; whether Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden continue south of it cannot be seen. Hoffner Avenue: printed 55 ft, edges read at y about 262-268 and 405-410; the streets from the south end at it (Wesleyan Cemetery to the north). Printed 'HOFFNER' with no suffix; Llewellyn, Borden, Kirby, Gordon, Florida printed 'ST.'. Nothing but cemetery, creek and unplatted land between y 2000 and 5250.
